description_en: You can view the configuration of MongoDB Log Service
name: DescribeMongoDBLogConfig

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61939.html to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61939.html进行查询
parameters.name: db_instance_id

EnableAudit.description_en:
Indicates whether the audit log feature is enabled for the ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance.

true: Enabled.

false: Disabled
EnableAudit.description_zh:
是否开启云数据库MongoDB审计日志功能。

true：开启。
false：未开启

HotTtlForV2Standard.description_en: The retention period of hot storage for the V2_Standard (DAS Enterprise Edition (NoSQL-compatible)) version of audit logs. Unit: days
HotTtlForV2Standard.description_zh: 在V2_Standard（DAS企业版(NOSQL兼容)审计日志）版本审计日志中表示热存储天数

IsEtlMetaExist.description_en:
Indicates whether a rule is created to ship audit logs to Logtail. For more information about Logtail, see [What is Logtail?]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28979.html）. Valid values:

1: A rule is created.

0 or null: No rule is created
IsEtlMetaExist.description_zh:
是否已创建将审计日志分发到Logtail的规则。关于Logtail的详细信息，请参见[Logtail简介]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28979.html）。取值：
1：已创建。
0或null：未创建

IsUserProjectLogstoreExist.description_en:
Indicates whether a Simple Log Service project for audit logs exists in the current region. Valid values:

1: The project exists.

0 or null: The project does not exist
IsUserProjectLogstoreExist.description_zh:
当前地域中是否存在审计日志的project。取值：
1：存在。
0或null：不存在

PreserveStorageForStandard.description_en: The maximum storage capacity for the official version of audit logs. A value of -1 indicates that no upper limit is set
PreserveStorageForStandard.description_zh: 正式版审计日志可使用存储容量的上限。如果值为-1，说明未设置上限

PreserveStorageForTrail.description_en: The maximum storage capacity for the free trial version of audit logs. Unit: bytes. The maximum value is 107374182400 bytes
PreserveStorageForTrail.description_zh: 免费试用版审计日志可使用存储容量的上限，单位为字节。可设置最高上限为107374182400字节

ServiceType.description_en:
The version of the audit log feature.

Trial: Free trial version.

Standard: Official version.

V2_Standard: DAS Enterprise Edition (NoSQL-compatible) version
ServiceType.description_zh:
审计日志的版本类型。
Trial：免费试用版。
Standard：正式版。
V2_Standard： DAS企业版(NOSQL兼容)版本

TtlForStandard.description_en: The retention period of audit logs for the official version. The value ranges from 1 to 365. Unit: days
TtlForStandard.description_zh: 正式版审计日志的保留时长，取值范围为1~365天

TtlForTrail.description_en: The retention period of audit logs for the free trial version. Unit: days
TtlForTrail.description_zh: 免费试用版审计日志的保留时长，单位为天

TtlForV2Standard.description_en: The retention period of cold storage for the V2_Standard (DAS Enterprise Edition (NoSQL-compatible)) version of audit logs. Unit: days
TtlForV2Standard.description_zh: 在V2_Standard（DAS企业版(NOSQL兼容)审计日志）版本审计日志中表示冷存储天数

UsedStorageForStandard.description_en: The storage capacity that is used by audit logs for the official version. Unit: bytes
UsedStorageForStandard.description_zh: 正式版审计日志已使用的存储容量，单位为字节

UsedStorageForTrail.description_en: The storage capacity that is used by audit logs for the free trial version. Unit: bytes
UsedStorageForTrail.description_zh: 免费试用版审计日志已使用的存储容量，单位为字节

UserProjectName.description_en: The name of the Simple Log Service project for the audit logs
